final: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, risk_margin_records, risk_margin_records * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records * 1.0 / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts
